See also: Paints
Interesting facts
Paint first appeared on February 6, 2015.
Prior to the Paint Separation Update, Vortex was worth 35,500 crystals and could be bought from Warrant Officer 4.
Legacy paint description:
A paint providing medium protection against Vulcan, Ricochet and Thunder. Will help in combat at medium and long ranges. Covers your tank in a quirky pattern.
The paint was added to containers on January 14th, 2022.
